bibliographic.title: Together in the Rain
bibliographic.author: A Fals Fiction
bibliographic.description:
Choose the path for Eidir and Rouslen, a couple in need of refuge from war.

There are three potential endings. Decisions can lead to relief or to untimely death.

This is a tiny interactive fiction in only 500 words.

== Credits ==

Story & design were self-made using Twine, HTML, and CSS.

Music is from TomMusic.

Cover art was made in Aseprite and Krita.

With thanks as always to my game testers. (Publishing mistakes are my own.)
